# scenario-size

Limit the number of steps in a Scenario.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| structure | no | no | `{"maxSteps":12}` |

Limits direct Scenario steps, not Background steps.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "scenario-size": ["error", {"maxSteps":12}] } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
Scenario: long flow
  Given one
  When two
  Then three
```
